 Hello, healthy ears! Puro Sound Labs PuroBasic headphones are safer headphones for kids, a solution for your child's hearing, and the sound is incredibly crisp. PuroBasic also implements Puro Sound Labs' patent-pending Balanced Response Curve, which optimizes sound quality at lower volume levels, meaning you can listen to every aspect of audio without the need to turn up the volume. PuroBasic have a lightweight yet durable construction, with ergonomic super soft vegan leather pads and an adjustable headband to fit different head sizes and shapes. The universal 3.5mm audio cable allows connection with all audio devices and is perfect for use at home or school. A foldable design and soft carrying case make the PuroBasic portable and perfect for storing in a backpack, and the four bright colors provide options for boys and girls. PuroBasic is backed by Puro Sound's one-year warranty, which means you have safer premium sound.

# Puro Sound Labs - Kids Headphones, Volume-Limiting 85dB, PuroBasic, Purple
Brand: Puro Sound Labs
Category: Headphones & Earbuds > Over-Ear Headphones

## Features
SAFER LISTENING FOR KIDS: Puro Sound Labs little kids headphones feature a built-in volume limiter that caps sound at 85dB, protecting young ears while delivering quality audio. Ideal as music headphones for kids, for online learning, travel, or everyday use.; COMFORTABLE & ADJUSTABLE FIT: These kids headphones wired feature a plush, adjustable headband and soft, breathable ear cushions for a comfortable fit. Ideal for long study sessions, gaming, and as kids travel headphones, they ensure hours of cozy listening.; DURABLE & PORTABLE DESIGN: Built with a rugged, flexible plastic frame, these wired headphones for kids for kids are made to last. The foldable ear cups and included drawstring bag make them easy to carry and store anywhere you go. Ideal for travel and as a school headphones for kids.; SEAMLESS CONNECTIVITY & CLEAR COMMUNICATION: These kid headphones come with a 3.5mm audio jack and built-in microphone, ensuring clear communication during calls or online classes. Compatible with smartphones, tablets, and PCs— ideal as kids headphone for learning and entertainment.; IDEAL FOR LEARNING & PLAY: Give your child our kids headphones for school that balance safety and performance. With a durable, everyday design and a safe listening volume, they are perfect for everything from classroom lessons to long car rides.

## Specifications
Color: Purple; Enclosure Material: Plastic; Additional Features: Foldable, Lightweight, Microphone Included; Built-In Media: Drawstring Bag; Age Range Description: Kid

## Pricing & Reviews
Rated 4.2 from 1395 reviews.

## Details
Model: PB. UPC: 854381006959

## Description
Product Description Looking for the ideal wired kids volume limiting headphones? The PuroSound Labs PuroBasic Wired Headphones offer a safer, more comfortable, and quality listening experience. With a built-in volume limiter that caps sound at 85dB, these wired headphones for kids protect your child’s hearing while delivering clear audio. Ideal for child headphones for school, they ensure your child’s ears stay safe without compromising sound quality. The soft ear cushions and adjustable headband provide a comfortable, secure fit for long study sessions, gaming, or watching videos. Designed for comfort and durability, these wired headphones with mic for kids are ideal for everything from online learning to leisure time. Durability is built in, with a rugged, flexible plastic frame that can withstand daily use. The foldable ear cups make it easy to store, and the included drawstring bag adds convenience for travel. These headphones for boys and girls are ideal for school, travel, or family trips, keeping your child’s headphones safe and secure on the go. Equipped with a 3.5mm audio jack and built-in microphone, these toddler headphones allow clear communication during calls, online classes, or gaming. Compatible with smartphones, tablets, and PCs, they’re ideal for both learning and play. Adjustable and flexible, toddler headphones for 2+ year old. The detachable earcups offer a personalized fit, ensuring comfort and safety for all kinds of activities. Choose PuroSound Labs PuroBasic Wired Headphones – the safer, durable, and comfortable solution for your child’s audio needs!
